name: Expenses help
description: Help mode entries for Molly's Expenses plugin (help@1).
author: Brett

entries.title: Expenses
entries.text: Your Expense Tracker ledger, paydays and reports, right inside Molly. Same ledger as expenses.amberxai.com.

entries.title: Add entry
entries.text: Adds a spending or income entry. Tap a row to change it.

entries.title: Add missing paydays
entries.text: Writes every payday your schedule says you should have had and the ledger is missing. Running it twice adds nothing.

entries.title: Copy report
entries.text: Copies the report on screen as plain text.

entries.title: Export CSV
entries.text: Downloads the whole ledger as a spreadsheet file.
